trigger: Run only after admitted complete EXP0054 if proposed vctpg_ac at 32768 has zero registered safe successes, any spacing violation, or no AUC advantage over the strongest classical comparator. All denominators retained.
rationale: Original wall reward trades 27 cluster-seconds for one percentage point of removal, despite <1 cluster-second registered safety requirement. Safety arm makes that ratio 1 second; this is a declared training hyperparameter, not a clinical valuation or constraint guarantee.
matched_control: Both regimes start from each method's same frozen 32768 parent and receive 16384 new physical controls with fresh Adam optimizers. Original-reward continuation controls for extra data/optimization. Actor/critic architecture, observations, simulator, spacing threshold and scored safety definition stay unchanged.
shared_optimization_repair: Both reward regimes clip actor and critic gradient norms separately at 0.5. A large value loss must not rescale policy gradients through a combined clipping norm. Log both unclipped norms. This standard optimization repair applies to MAPPO/IPPO/proposed/no-ac equally; parent-to-child improvement cannot be attributed solely to reward or novelty.
selection: All four methods, both reward regimes and all three seeds; no selecting successful runs. Final extra-16384 checkpoint only; cumulative49152 total controls per policy, not a16384-from-scratch claim. No confirmation access.
novelty_boundary: Changing reward scale is a training remedy, not claimed algorithmic novelty. Action-conditioned representation remains a hypothesis tested against no-ac and MAPPO/IPPO under the same regime.
